title: Vortex Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Pineapple Ice captures the vibrant sweetness of tropical Pineapple, perfectly complemented by a refreshing menthol kick on the exhale. This tropical delight offers a balance of bold fruitiness and cool refreshment, creating a flavour that’s both bright and satisfying. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides rich flavour and smooth vapour, perfect for use with Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices. Its nic salt formulation ensures a gentle throat hit and quick nicotine satisfaction, making it an excellent choice for everyday vaping. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts are presented in a 10ml format as a more sustainable and economical alternative to disposable vape bars, designed for use with refillable vape kits. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Pineapple Ice is a must-try for fans of tropical and icy flavour blends.
